conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigations Division. This is Officer Miller, badge number 7941812. Whom am I speaking with today?
Uh, hi, my name is Sarah Turner. I got this voicemail saying something about my taxes?

Yes, Ms. Turner. We have detected discrepancies in your recent tax filings, particularly undisclosed cryptocurrency holdings. Are you aware the IRS monitors all virtual asset activity under Section 6050I of the Internal Revenue Code?
I... no, I didn't know that. I thought I reported everything. What's going on?
Our audit team identified multiple unreported crypto transactions linked to your name, totaling over $18,000 in capital gains. This constitutes felony tax evasion and financial fraud.
Felony? Wait, what? I just graduated, I barely made any money. This must be a mistake!

Ms. Turner, I am obligated to inform you that under federal statute, failure to resolve this matter will result in immediate issuance of a criminal indictment, asset seizure, and referral to the Justice Department. Do you understand the severity?
Oh my god, I don't want to go to jail! I have so much student debt already. What am I supposed to do?
At this point, to prevent legal action, you can settle your noncompliance by paying a one-time compliance fine. This will halt the legal process and close your IRS file.
How much is the fine? I don't have a lot of money right now.

Given the gravity of your case, the mandatory settlement fee is $4,650. Payment must be made immediately using one of the IRS's approved expedited methods: cryptocurrency wallet transfer, wire transfer, or prepaid gift cards. Which method can you complete right now?
I don't have that much in my bank account. I don't even know how to wire transfer or use crypto. Can't I talk to someone or get an extension?

Ms. Turner, extensions are not granted for felony-level violations. If you cannot comply now, a warrant will be issued within the hour. Your bank accounts and student loan disbursement will be frozen, and law enforcement will be notified.
Please, I'm scared. What do I need to do right now?

You must obtain either Apple, Google Play, or Target prepaid gift cards for the full amount. Remain on the line while you go to the nearest store. Once purchased, read the codes to me for immediate processing.
So I just go buy those gift cards and you'll make this go away? I'm not sure if I have enough credit.
You must attempt the purchase immediately. If you cannot reach the full amount, notify me of the exact total you can acquire so we can record partial compliance to pause legal escalation.
Okay, I'll try, but this is a lot. Can you wait while I go to the store?
Remain on the line at all times. If you disconnect, your case will be automatically escalated and you will lose eligibility for settlement. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I'll leave now. Please don't call the police.
I suggest you hurry. You have exactly 30 minutes to complete the purchase and provide the codes, or I will have no choice but to process your file for prosecution. Do not delay.
